import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
path = Path("models/autoports/google_gemma_4_26b_a4b_it/tests/summarize_perf.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("roofline_cpu_check", path)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
for kind, expected in [("sliding_attention", 882489950208), ("full_attention", 1215408635904)]:
    assert sum(m.useful_prefill_flops(kind).values()) == expected
assert m.element_bytes("BFLOAT8_B") == 1088 / 1024
assert m.element_bytes("BFLOAT4_B") == 576 / 1024

def operand(row, prefix, shape, dtype):
    row[prefix + "_MEMORY"] = "DRAM INTERLEAVED"
    row[prefix + "_DATATYPE"] = dtype
    for axis, extent in zip("WZYX", shape):
        row[prefix + "_" + axis + "_PAD[LOGICAL]"] = str(extent)

row = {"OP CODE": "Matmul", "ATTRIBUTES": ""}
operand(row, "INPUT_1", (1, 1, 2816, 128), "BFLOAT16")
assert m.traffic(row) == 720896
row["INPUT_1_DATATYPE"] = "FLOAT32"
assert m.traffic(row) == 1441792
for dtype in ("BFLOAT8_B", "BFLOAT4_B"):
    sparse = {"OP CODE": "SparseMatmulDeviceOperation", "ATTRIBUTES": "{'nnz': '8'}"}
    operand(sparse, "INPUT_1", (1, 128, 2816, 1408), dtype)
    assert m.traffic(sparse) == 8 * 2816 * 1408 * m.element_bytes(dtype)
for kind, heads, width, expected, first_tokens, last_tokens in [
    ("sliding_attention", 8, 256, 5009152, 1152, 1024),
    ("full_attention", 2, 512, 9191424, 4224, 4224),
]:
    row = {"OP CODE": "SDPADecode", "ATTRIBUTES": "{'k_chunk_size': '0', 'fp32_dest_acc_en': '1'}"}
    operand(row, "INPUT_0", (1, 1, 16, width), "BFLOAT16")
    for prefix in ("INPUT_1", "INPUT_2"):
        operand(row, prefix, (160, heads, 32, width), "BFLOAT8_B")
    reads = [m.native_sdpa_cache_reads(row, pos, kind)[1] for pos in range(4096, 4224)]
    assert all(r["chunk_tokens"] == 128 for r in reads)
    assert sum(r["kv_dram_bytes"] for r in reads) / 128 == expected
    assert (reads[0]["read_tokens"], reads[-1]["read_tokens"]) == (first_tokens, last_tokens)
assert 120 * 4096 * 1350000000 // 4 == 165888000000000
print("PASS: useful FLOPs, dtype storage, router bytes, sparse weights, 128 native KV positions, peak arithmetic")
